story_generator.name: Story Generator
story_generator.notes: A friendly error screen instead of the red crash page (disk full and other errors keep the program running); outputs and prompt files are never overwritten or left half-written; saving and exporting images no longer freezes the window; Prompt Lab: pick several APIs for one prompt (same dialog as Gallery Generator), REPLY / PROMPT / END answers read only the two blocks, layouts for small windows (down to 900x600), redesigned LLM Settings, default Max Tokens 8192; Batch Editor: Open original / exported folder in the card menu, searchable Prompt History (double-click to use); Gallery Generator: Add all / Remove all and double-click in Add APIs
